title: Beyblade
description: Beyblade Original SeriesBeyblade (Season 1)Beyblade V-force (Season 2)Beyblade G-revolution (Season 3)Thirteen-year-old Tyson Granger (Takao Kinomiya), along with his fellow teammates, Kai Hiwatari, Max Tate (Max Mizuhura), and Ray Kon (Rei Kon), strive to become the greatest Beybladers in the world. With the technical help of the team’s resident genius, Kenny (Kyouju), and with the powerful strength of their BitBeasts, the Bladebreakers armed with their tops (AKA: Blades) attempt to reach their goal.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x1
episodes_data.description: Tyson is caught up in the sport of Beyblading, but can he balance Beyblading and martial arts?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x2
episodes_data.description: When Tyson and Kai end up battling against each other, Tyson is easily defeated. Can he unlock a mythical bit beast to even the score?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x3
episodes_data.description: Can Kenny's friendship with Tyson continue when a new kid named Max seems to be stealing Tyson away?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x4
episodes_data.description: Max and Tyson arrive at the tournament and Tyson faces his first opponent.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x5
episodes_data.description: The first matchup in the semi-finals is Max vs. Kai. Can Max pull the upset off without a bitbeast giving him support?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x6
episodes_data.description: The mysterious blader Ray and Tyson do battle in the second round. Can Tyson survive the mysterious Tiger Claw Attack?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x7
episodes_data.description: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set -- with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson that the rookie sensation realizes he has forgotten his own birthday, but what will Kai have in store for him?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x8
episodes_data.description: Tyson and his new team, the Bladebreakers, prepare for the World Championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x9
episodes_data.description: Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian World   Championships when they run into Ray's old gang, the White Tigers. Naturally, a Beyblade battle quickly ensues.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x10
episodes_data.description: The Bladebreakers discover that them and the White Tigers are in different divisons. To face them, they'll have to make it to the finals, but can the Unknown Tall Boys shock everyone and defeat the Bladebreakers ending all national title hopes?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x11
episodes_data.description: Kevin decides to try and destroy Ray by stealing his data. What will happen if Kevin succeeds? Will the Bladebreakers have any chance of winning the Asian tournament, or will something worse happen?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x12
episodes_data.description: With his bitbeast gone, Ray loses all confidence and decides to leave the Bladebreakers. Can Tyson convience him to come back, or will Mariah convience him that the White Tigers team is his real home?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x13
episodes_data.description: With the Bladebreakers having impressed everyone, the White Tigers decide to get serious. Can they show everyone why they are the best?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x14
episodes_data.description: A rockslide makes Tyson and Ray fall behind on their way to the semi-final matchup. Can they make it on time, or will a forfit keep the Bladebreakers from a showdown with the White Tigers?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x15
episodes_data.description: The Asian finals begin between Max and Gary, but Gary's open-mindedness makes everyone think he can't win a thing. Will Gary's true wrath be unleashed to show why he battles instead of Kevin?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x16
episodes_data.description: Ray and Mariah get ready to go head to head, but can these two lovers put aside their feelings for the match. Maybe their bitbeasts will have something to say about it.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x17
episodes_data.description: When Tyson and Lee's matchup turns out to be a draw, it's up to Ray to defeat his old team and keep Driger. How will Driger and Ray react to this news?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x18
episodes_data.description: With the Asian Tournament over, the Bladebreakers head home for a small break, but what will happen now that Tyson feels he has power?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x19
episodes_data.description: Max insists on seeing his mom before the American tournament, but what will he do when he finds out she works for the opposing team?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x20
episodes_data.description: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x21
episodes_data.description: Can the Bladebreakers gain their confidence back after seeing all the fancy American equipment?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x22
episodes_data.description: When Max participates in a charity Beyblade event, he must teach Emily what team work is all about. Can he succeed?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x23
episodes_data.description: The American tournament begins in Las Vegas. Will Kai decide to show the All Starz his true power?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x24
episodes_data.description: The Blade Breakers decide to study the All Starz moves so they can become stronger. Will they succeed?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x25
episodes_data.description: When Tyson gets a stomachache before the semi-finals, Kai must step up and take his place. Can the Bladebreakers keep their momentum going in the mysterious New Jersey Turnpike?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x26
episodes_data.description: Tyson's health is restored before the finals, so he gets ready to battle again. Can Max help them realize he can defeat his mom's team, or will Kai get the final spot?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x27
episodes_data.description: The finals continue. Can the Blade Breakers muster the strength to win, or will the All Starz become the new American Champions?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x28
episodes_data.description: It's Max versus Michael for the American team championship. Which team will end up being victorious?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x29
episodes_data.description: Kenny ponders how the Bladebreakers got together, and he wonders what the next touranment will bring.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x30
episodes_data.description: When the Bladebreakers run into Robert on a ship to Russia, they realize just how much their bitbeasts need to develop. Can they learn how to gain the strength needed?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x31
episodes_data.description: When the Bladebreakers arrive in London, a mysterious tape about evil bitbeasts is waiting for Tyson. Can they interpret what Tyson's father is trying to tell them before they encounter an evil bitbeast, or is it already to late?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x32
episodes_data.description: The Dark Bladers try once again to steal the Bladebreakers bitbeasts and turn them evil in a subway tunnel. Will they succeed?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x33
episodes_data.description: The Blade Breakers arrive in Paris, but the Dark Bladers follow them there. Can the Blade Breakers handle one more battle with the Dark Bladers, or will additional and unexpected help come to save them?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x34
episodes_data.description: Tyson determines to battle the blader named Oliver, but does he have any chance at victory?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x35
episodes_data.description: The Blade Breakers arrive in Rome to battle against their next opponent, Enrique. Can Tyson finally successfully defeat one of Europe's top bladers, or will he learn that he has a lot of skills to develop?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x36
episodes_data.description: Tyson determines that he must defeat Enrique if his reputation as a top Beyblader is to be restored, but when Oliver arrives it becomes 2 of Europe's top bladers against Tyson's ego. Can he figure out a way to show that bitbeasts should be used for more than just power?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x37
episodes_data.description: Enrique and Oliver take the Blade Breakers to Robert's mansion, but can Tyson get his rematch against Robert, or will this Johnny character interfer?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x38
episodes_data.description: The Blade Breakers decide to challenge Robert, Johnny, Enrique, and Oliver to a team battle. They accept, but can ""The Majestics"" work together as a team when they've been individual fighters their entire life?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x39
episodes_data.description: It's Kai versus Johnny and Tyson versus Robert for the right to go to the World Championships in Russia. Who will win the bout?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x40
episodes_data.description: A mysterious man named Boris invites the Bladebreakers to his physilities for a practice battle. Should they trust him, and if they do, then can they win the battle?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x41
episodes_data.description: Kai investigates Boris' Abbey since he feels some sort of draw to it. What will he find? Also, Max meets up with the All Starz and Ray meets up with the White Tigers. Why have they come to Russia?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x42
episodes_data.description: Kai must choose whether he wants the power of Dark Dranzer or the friendship of the Blade Breakers. Which will he decide?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x43
episodes_data.description: While the Bladebreakers try and find out what Kai's doing, the All Starz get ready to scrimmage the Demolition Boys, but when Kai shows up on the Demolition Boys and challenges all 4 All Starz at once, you know fire works will erupt. What will he do?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x44
episodes_data.description: The White Tigers determine to get revenge on Kai for the All Starz, but will they need to when Tyson and the Bladebreakers decide to try and talk some sense into Kai?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x45
episodes_data.description: Kai decides he wants all of the bitbeast, so he challenges the Bladebreakers to a match. Will they stand a chance without Max, who's with his mom at the airport?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x46
episodes_data.description: Kai and Tyson's father appear to let everyone know what Biovalt is really up to. Can the Bladebreakers find a way to stop them?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x47
episodes_data.description: The Majestics show up in Russia with a challenge for the Bladebreakers, defeat them in a match, or lose their bitbeasts. Why have they come to Russia, and why do they want the Bladebreakes bitbeasts?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x48
episodes_data.description: Kai is given a tempting offer from his grandfather Voltaire, use dark Dranzer, or risk losing Dranzer forever. Will he give in?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x49
episodes_data.description: With Kai losing in the first round, Ray must find some way to even up the score. Can he find the strength to do so, and if he does, will he risk losing Drigger forever?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x50
episodes_data.description: When Tala gets cyber implants and Tyson gets new blading equipment, you know their match strategy's are bound to change, but just how will the changes affect the championship?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 1x51
episodes_data.description: A grave meeting is held between the Majestics, Kevin of the White Tigers, and the Dark Bladers in case Tyson should lose the match. Can Tyson survive in this other dimension, or will the Demolition Boys become World Champions and rulers?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x1
episodes_data.description: Tyson starts the new season arrogant as always. There is a new blader in town called Mr. X. Can Tyson defeat him?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x2
episodes_data.description: Tyson is more determined than ever to face Mr. X again. Meanwhile Ray and Max are defeated by mysterious bladers as well. Is Chief to late to stop Tyson from battling Mr. X again?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x3
episodes_data.description: Chief in on his way to tell Tyson what he has learned about the three mysterious bladers. We find out Mr. X's name is Ozuma. Chief, Tyson, and Hilary are to mee to discuss tactics. When Tyson arrives to meet the other two they are gone. What happened to them?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x4
episodes_data.description: Tyson has to track down what happened to Chief and Hilary. He is led to a run down boat that transports him to a room with a glass front. Can Tyson save his two friends?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x5
episodes_data.description: Chief can only assume that since Tyson, Ray, and Max have been defeated by mysterious bladers that Kai is next. Is Chief right? Meanwhile Kai is back in school and meets a guy named Wyatt.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x6
episodes_data.description: Gideon, the one who is bhind the kidnapping of Chief and Hilary, has got him a new recruit by the name of Snakey. Can Snakey defeat Tyson and Dragoon?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x7
episodes_data.description: After reviewing Tyson and Snakey's battle Dizzi and Chief figure out Snakey was using a Magtram-enhanced Beyblade. The same metal that was used on the boat Tyson was on. Gideon has a team called Team Psykick. Can the Bladebreakers defeat Team Psykick?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x8
episodes_data.description: The newly reunited Bladebreakers begin training for their upcoming battle with Team Psykick.  Armed with the new MG Core, which will give the team complete control of their blades, one question comes to mind. Can they manage to learn to use the core correctly?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x9
episodes_data.description: The Bladebreakers are trapped on an island. Max is the first to battle against a character named Chameleon, but what tricks does Chameleon have in store for him, and why did team Psykick drag them all the way out to an unknown island?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x10
episodes_data.description: Ray is next to battle a guy named Bat, who can see in the dark. Can Ray overcome not seeing in the dark to keep his bitbeast Driger?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x11
episodes_data.description: After Kai's win against Figel, he joins Kenny and Hilary to resume their journey to the lighthouse. From there the heroes hope to get a clear satellite signal to call for help.  Will they be able to call for help before Daryl takes on the wounded Tyson?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x12
episodes_data.description: Gideon plans to create his own Cyber Bit Beasts but lacks vital data on Dranzer. Meanwhile the Saint Shields plan their own attack on Dranzer and send Dunga to do the job. Will the Blade Breakers realize there's a conspiracy against them before it's too late?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x13
episodes_data.description: Joseph decides to find out what the Psykicks are doing with the data they've collected from their matchups with the BladeBreakers. His discoveries cause them to escalate matchups against the BladeBreakers as they secretly test Max & Ray in a two vs. two battle against Miriam & Joseph. Who will win the match-up, and just what did Joseph discover?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x14
episodes_data.description: Doctor B unveils the first Cyber Bit Beast to the world. Gerry from Team Psykick is chosen to be the first to wield this new Beyblade. What can possibly go wrong with an untested, experimental, extremely powerful, Mad Scientist created Bit Beast?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x15
episodes_data.description: Kenny discovers that someone has made copies of all the Blade Breakers' Bit Beasts and the team decides to prepare themselves for battle. Hilary feels left out because she can't see the team's Bit Beasts so she joins the gang in their training.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x16
episodes_data.description: Dr. B and his team have finally perfected the Cyber Bit Beast and are ready to test it on the BladeBreakers, but first they need to find a Blader strong enough to take on the challenge.  Will Kai's classmate Wyatt be just the Blader they're looking for?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x17
episodes_data.description: Getting fed up with the rest of the team, Tyson decides to quit. This doesn't last for long, when his insatiable appetite lures him back into the fold.  Grandpa's fishing doesn't work out according to plan either. The catch of the day has turned the tides on this old man, but who are these new bladers that save him. Can the BladeBreakers trust them?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x18
episodes_data.description: The Blade Breakers sneak into Doctor B's lab, where Tyson learns that the dreaded Psykick's have recruited his new pal Kane into their ranks, but can they convience them to leave the Psykicks, or have the Cyber Bit Beast already begun taking them over?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x19
episodes_data.description: After seeing the Cyber Bit Beasts in action, Tyson vows to do whatever it takes to beat them. Ray develops an unexpected friendship with Salima of Team Psykick in the hopes of learning more about their next challenge, but is she really to be trusted, or is she planning on taking Ray down some how?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x20
episodes_data.description: Tyson struggles to control his new ""tricked out"" Beyblade. His frustration leads him to battle Ozuma who is always around to teach Tyson a lesson when he needs one. Will Tyson finally be able to defeat Ozuma, or will Ozuma destroy Tyson's blade and ego for good?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x21
episodes_data.description: The Bladebreakers and Hilary head for their battle against Team Psykick in a helicopter. They are met in the Battle Tower by robots. Luckily the Saint Shields are there to cover their backs. Max and Jim are the first two to battle. Who will win the first round?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x22
episodes_data.description: Jim and Cyber Draciel appear to have the upper hand due to the Cyber repair system, but can Max find a way to make defeat into victory?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x23
episodes_data.description: Selima and Ray battle head to head in the second match up, but will Cyber Driger prove to be too strong for Driger, or will driger's previous power fully return?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x24
episodes_data.description: Kai squares off against Goki on Level Four of Gideon's Battle Tower. But when his real opponent turns out to be the ghost of his friend Wyatt, Kai finds himself helpless.  Can the Bladebreakers help Kai lay his guilt to rest or is this the Bladebreakers final defeat?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x25
episodes_data.description: The final battle between Tyson and Kane begins with a shock. Kane actually decides to battle fair without the help of Cyber Dragoon, but can this resolve last long, or will Tyson and Dragoon see powers they never could have imagined?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x26
episodes_data.description: Tyson faces off against Kane only to discover that Kane has fallen under the control of his Cyber Bit Beast. Tyson reluctantly tells Dragoon to give up, but will Dragoon listen, or will his loyal Bit Beast summon the strength to keep fighting and inspire Tyson to do the same?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x27
episodes_data.description: At the conclusion of the fierce battle between Tyson and Kane, the Battle Tower starts to collapse around them.  During their mad dash to make it out of the building, Max realizes that Draciel is still inside. How will he get him out of there?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x28
episodes_data.description: The Bladebreakers and Hilary head off for NYC. Max's mom Judy is their to greet them. Judy unveils a secret rock to the BladeBreakers, but when it gets stolen its up to the BladeBreakers to get it back. Can they succeed?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x29
episodes_data.description: As it turns out Max's friend Alan was part of the scheme to steal the powerful rock. Can Max manage to defeat Alan and get him to reveal what's going on?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x30
episodes_data.description: The Bladebreakers return to Japan accompanied by Judy. Mr. Dickenson tells all of them about a partner he used to work with named Dr. Zagart. Tyson has to learn to control his new Beyblade Dragoon V2. The Saint Shields decide to efeat Tyson before he can learn to control his new blade, but will they succeed when a mysterious fighter appears?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x31
episodes_data.description: The search for the missing rock  and the mysterious Dr. Zagart goes on. Unfortunately the BladeBreakers are at a loss as to where they should look. When Foxy challenges Ray to a match, the team unknowingly moves a step closer to solving the mystery, but first they have to defeat Foxy. Will they succeed?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x32
episodes_data.description: After Foxy's attack, the team has many questions, but few answers. Who was behind the attack and how is the rock involved?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x33
episodes_data.description: When Ray loses Driger to Dunga's Vortex Ape, the Bladebreakers resolve to go back into training and rescue him. But will they be able to save Driger without putting themselves into further jeopardy? And what is Dunga's real reason for taking Ray's bit-beast?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x34
episodes_data.description: Tyson runs into a sticky situation while trying to figure out how to get Driger back.  Net and his Bit Beast Spider coax Tyson into releasing Dragoon so they can capture it for their own goals. Will he be able to escape from this web slinging assassin?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x35
episodes_data.description: There's a new Blader after Kai's Bit beast and he's ready for battle. The only problem is he's quiet as the wind and as strong as a hurricane. How can Kai possibly beat an opponent that he can't even see?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x36
episodes_data.description: After Max is ambushed, Mariam discovers that Dr. K is using Power Injection to make the Bit Beast, Tyranno stronger. When Mariam destroys much of the building, she and Max must work together to find a way out. But will Mariam capture Draciel once they escape?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x37
episodes_data.description: With the goal of acquiring the BladeBreakers Bit Beasts and sealing them in a rock, The Saint Shields challenge them to a match at an abandoned amusement park. The first match is Miriam versus Max, but will Max manage to win, or is Draciel done for?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x38
episodes_data.description: The Saint Shields have already captured Ray's Bit Beast, Driger, and now they've set their sights on capturing Kai's Dranzer. Dunga goes into battle against Kai and the fight intensifies as the blades race along the rails of an abandoned roller coaster to what looks like their doom. Can any of them survive?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x39
episodes_data.description: Ozuma, leader of the Saint Shields gang makes a final play for the BladeBreakers four Bit Beasts. During his battle with Tyson, it is revealed that he comes from an ancient group that is sworn to capture and contain all the Bit Beasts in the world, but will this new found knowledge give the BladeBreakers the know how to defeat Ozuma, or is Dragoon done or?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x40
episodes_data.description: Pleased that the Saint Shields no longer wish to seal the four Bit Beasts, Dr. K gives a new Blader, Denny, a powerful rock Bit Beast named Clarken and orders him to capture the four Sacred Bit Beasts.  Meanwhile, Zeo catches up with the Bladebreakers and shows them his invitation to the upcoming World Championships, but when Denny shows up to destroy their practice, can Zeo help them win the day?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x41
episodes_data.description: The BladeBreakers show up at the World Championship Tournament and go up into the stands to cheer on Zeo who's fighting in the preliminaries, but a shocking turn of events is about to occur for Zeo. Find out what it is when you finally meet Zeo's dad.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x42
episodes_data.description: Zeo focuses on Beyblade training with his father Zagart. The most powerful rock Bit-Beast named Cerberus is designated for Zeo, but he must first be able to summon it. Zeo trains furiously, but the elusive Bit Beast never fully materializes. Meanwhile, the Bladebreakers must choose their two team-pairs for the World Beyblade Championships, but what will be their teams and can Zeo really become the BladeBreakers enemy?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x43
episodes_data.description: While all that the BladeBreakers can think of are the finals, Kai can't stop obsessing about King and Queen.  With a brand new Beyblade crafted for him by Kenny, Kai longs for a rematch. But Kai isn't the only one with the royal pair on his mind. Doctor K tracks the duo down and offers them a chance to team up with her so they can capture and wield the power of the four sacred Bit Beasts together. What will King and Queen end up doing, and can Kai get his revenge on the duo?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x44
episodes_data.description: After disappearing thirty years ago, Zagart confronts Mr. Dickenson, forcing him to enter Zeo in the World Championship Finals. He reveals that Zeo is his son and that he won't show mercy when he confronts the Bladebreakers in the tournament. Meanwhile, the pairings for the finals are announced, but King and Queen want to start the fun a bit early. Can Mr. Dickenson stop chaos from occuring, or will it take someone else a bit stronger?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x45
episodes_data.description: The Beyblade World Championship Finals are underway and eight teams convene to compete for the title. The BladeBreakers are shocked to see that their old friend Zeo is in the competition and Tyson confronts him to find out why he has decided to compete against them. Will Zeo reveal the truth, or can the Saint Shields knock Zeo out of the tournament?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x46
episodes_data.description: The World Beyblade Championships continue and the next round has Tyson and Max squaring off against Kane and Jim. Kane and Jim decide to have a little practice battle at the beach. But King and Queen show up for a surprise attack. Can Kane and Jim hold off the duo, or will the BladeBreakers or Saint Shields manage to show up and save the day?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x47
episodes_data.description: In the Semi-Final round of the World Beyblade Championships, Max & Tyson take on King & Queen. Doctor K tempts Queen into using a vicious new attack ring she's created called 'The Shredder'. Can Max and Tyson manage to overcome this new piece, or will they lose their sacred Bit Beasts?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x48
episodes_data.description: The second semi-final begins with Ray battling Gordo and Kai battling Zeo. Can the BladeBreakers manage to end Zeo's dreams now, or will the BladeBreakers have their worst nightmare yet come forth?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x49
episodes_data.description: The Bladebreakers begin to lose faith in each other, and Tyson contemplates Zeo's betrayal of them. Tyson decides to confront Zeo about it, but what will be the result, and will the other Bladebreakers support him?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x50
episodes_data.description: The Championship Finals begin as Tyson faces Gordo and Max faces Zeo. Can the BladeBreakers win both matches and repeat as champions, or will a 3rd and final match decide the outcome? Also, Zeo's secret will finally be revealed. All this occurs only on this episode of V-Force.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 2x51
episodes_data.description: The finals between Zeo and Tyson begin, but with Zeo being revealed to be a cyborg can Tyson gain the endurance to win this battle and remain the world champion?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x1
episodes_data.description: Tyson is home training kids after winning his second championship when two new challengers arrive. What do they want with the World Champion?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x2
episodes_data.description: The new rules of the World Championships cause changes to occur to the BladeBreakers, but will they be beneficial or harmful in the long run?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x3
episodes_data.description: With Ray and Max leaving the Bladebreakers to go to old teams, Jin decides to test Tyson, but when Ray ends up with the note he accepts Jin's challenge instead. Who will win between these two opponents?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x4
episodes_data.description: With Max and Ray having quit the team, it's up to Kenny to keep the remaining Bladebreakers together. Will he succeed?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x5
episodes_data.description: Tyson must once again prove he's the best in Block A, but a Chameleon blade has a few surprises in store for him and Kenny. Who will win he first final?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x6
episodes_data.description: It's Kai versus Daichi in the block B final. Who will become Tyson's teammate, and what surprises does Jin of the Gale have for the team?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x7
episodes_data.description: The BBA Revolution practices at Tyson's place while other qualifying matches are taking place, but who will the BBA Revolution end up facing? What surprises are in store for them?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x8
episodes_data.description: The new BBA Revolution team will be complete when Kai finally makes his decision as to what team he's going to be on. How will this affect the World Championships?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x9
episodes_data.description: The World Championships are about to begin, but now that Kai has left the BBA Revolution, he must side with someone else. Who will that end up being? Also, how well will Daichi and Tyson get along? Find out in this episode of GRevolution.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x10
episodes_data.description: The BBA Revolution battles White Tiger X in the first match of the World Championships, but which man will end up with the bragging rights: Tyson or Ray?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x11
episodes_data.description: Tyson has been totally out of control since Kai transferred to the Blitzkreig Boys, not to mention the defeat to the White Tigers. He can't admit it was his fault and gets into an argument with Daichi. Meanwhile Barthez leads a new team in the ways of cheating. Can Tyson and the rest of the bladers handle these new chalengers?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x12
episodes_data.description: The White Tigers battle the Barthez Battalion in the first beystage in Rome for this years world tournament. Which side will prevail? Will Ray become 2-0 and the favorite to win it all, or will the Bartez men give him a run for his money?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x13
episodes_data.description: Tyson is pulled from the battle against the Blitzkreig Boys and replaced by Kenny. What will this do to the BBA Revolution? Can Tyson get his ego under control finally?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x14
episodes_data.description: The Blitzkreig Boys are on a role and Tala defeats Kenny with a special attack! Next up to face Tala is Daichi. Even though Kenny lost to Tala, he has found a strategy to defeat him. But will Daichi use Kenny's plan for victory?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x15
episodes_data.description: Lee of the White Tigers X suffers a lack of sleep due to nightmares that further emphasizes his mediocre performance lately. Tired and fragile, he pushes himself hard enough to cause his Galeon to run out of control during the match against F-Dynasty! Will Ray really forfeit the match in order to help his friend?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x16
episodes_data.description: The Blitzkreg Boys battle the PBA All-Starz, and the truth behind the Barthez Battalion blades is revealed. What will this do to the World Championships?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x17
episodes_data.description: Finally, BBA Revolution faces off against the Barthez Battalion! Daichi faces off against Mathilda in the first match, but, following Barthez's evil plans, Mathilda reluctantly sacrifices her Beyblade to severly damage Daichi's Strata Dragoon, making it uncapable of fighting in a tie-breaker! Can Tyson win his match to achieve victory? And will Miguel finally make a stand to their cruel coach?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x18
episodes_data.description: The Barthez Battalion members must decide whether or not to cheat in their upcoming match against the Blitzkreig Boys, but which way will they decide?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x19
episodes_data.description: The White Tigers battle the All-Starz, but can the All-Starz handle a team that works together when they are divided at times?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x20
episodes_data.description: The BBA Revolution must battle F-Dynasty in a tag match, but who will come out as the winners and continue into the next round.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x21
episodes_data.description: Ever since his loss against F Dynasty, Tyson falls to the pressures of being world champion, so much so that he embarrasses himself during a BBA Revolution interview! Can a match with Daichi help regain Tyson's true fighting spirit at last?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x22
episodes_data.description: Raul tries to convince Julia he should battle Matilda in their battle against Barthez Battalions. Who will go to the semi-finals to meet the Blitzkreig boys?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x23
episodes_data.description: Ray and Kai go head to head, and the winner gets to face Tyson, but who will end up prevailing between Dranzer and Driger?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x24
episodes_data.description: Down in Australia, the BBA Revolution faces off against the PPB All-Starz. Everyone seems to believe that Rick will win in his match against Daichi, but the young boy is determined to prove to everyone that he will win! Can Daichi overcome Rick's Drop Rock attack so he can meet Tala of the Blitzkrieg Boys once again in the finals?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x25
episodes_data.description: The match between the BBA Revolution and the PPB All-Starz continues! Daichi has defeated Rick, so it's Max's turn to to battle with Tyson at last. Now that he has finally resolved his personal problems, will Tyson help the team move on to the next round? Will his Dragoon Galaxy even come out of this in one piece?!

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x26
episodes_data.description: The final rounds take place back in Japan! Equipped with his new blade, Dragoon Galaxy Turbo, Tyson and the rest of BBA Revolution must face F Dynasty once more to reach the dominating team, the Blitzkrieg Boys. Will Tyson and Daichi manage to redeem themselves from their last defeat and best Raul and Julia?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x27
episodes_data.description: The whole city is watching the semi-finals match between BBA revolution and F-dynasty in a tag-team format. Tyson and Daichi want to dethrone the tag-team champions and intend to use some of the twins own moves to do so. The winner moves on to the finals where the Blitzkrieg Boys are waiting!

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x28
episodes_data.description: The finals have finally arrived and BBA Revolution gets ready to face the Blitzkrieg Boys in a heated battle. But before that can happen, a routine check-up of Tyson's Beyblade turns up a faulty gear assembly, which needs to be repaired! Time is running out, and Daichi has to stretch out his match with Tala to give Kenny the time he needs to fix Dragoon!

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x29
episodes_data.description: Daichi and Tala have both been thrown from the dish at the same time, resulting in a tie game. Because they are in no condition for a rematch, Mr. Dickenson rules that the next match will determine the new tournament Champion. It all comes down to Kai and Tyson.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x30
episodes_data.description: It's the finals of the World Beyblading Championships and the final battle pits Kai against the defending world Champion, Tyson. The fight is incredibly intense and what's even more amazing, it looks like the two combatants are so evenly matched, there might not be a winner.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x31
episodes_data.description: The Beyblade World Championship finally concludes with BBA Revolution as the victorious team. However, an old wound opens in Daichi as he watches Tyson get all the attention once again. Will Daichi really leave the team for good?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x32
episodes_data.description: The BBA has been sold out, meaning Mr. Dickenson has no control over this mysterious new group, the Beyblade Entertainment Global Association: BEGA. Determined to find out what's going on, Tyson, Daichi, and Max challenge BEGA's mascot, the pop sensation, Ming Ming, to a battle! And, afterwards, Tyson meets a familiar face...

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x33
episodes_data.description: Boris returns after two years of travelling, and explains what he has seen has changed him and inspired him to create BEGA, in an effort to convice the gang, he gives Tyson, Max, Daichi and kenny a tour of their facilities. Tyson finds out BEGA aren't slacking when he battles Crusher, who's motives may change Tyson's mind about Boris.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x34
episodes_data.description: At China, Ray and his White Tiger X teammates return to their usual life routine until the next World Championship until they encounter a strange and mysterious youth named Mystel. Will Ray be able to trust this stranger, especially after Mystel claims that Tyson is an official member of BEGA?!

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x35
episodes_data.description: Tyson, still thinking whether Boris has changed at all, is unsure about joining BEGA. Tala, Spencer, and Bryan go to confront Boris once again and shut his organization down for good. The Blitzkrieg Boys thrash their first three opponents, but Bryan and Spencer are beaten by Garland, who is one of BEGA's top bladers! Will he be too much for even Tala to handle?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x36
episodes_data.description: In order to bring Boris' plan to a halt, Tala challenges Garland of Team Bega to a Beyblade match. But, Garland proves to be more than a match for him! Is Tala fighting a losing battle?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x37
episodes_data.description: Tyson accepts Boris' challenge to a five-on-five Beybattle for the future of the world of Beyblade. But, things are made worse when Kai joins BEGA and Hiro, as Jin of the Gale, becomes their new coach! It's up to Ray to bring Tyson back to his senses. But, since BEGA rules state that those who are not members cannot purchase new Beyblade parts, is this a battle they may end up regretting?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x38
episodes_data.description: While Tyson and the others find a way to make their own Beyblades, BEGA's influence continues to spread throughout the world. Hiro requests to coach BEGA's secret weapon, Brooklyn, but this young prodigy has a few surprises in store. Is it possible to be that powerful when Brooklyn never practiced a day in his life? Kai doesn't think so!

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x39
episodes_data.description: In a miraculous turn of events, the past teams from the recent tournament, White Tiger X, PPB All-Starz, F-Dynasty, and Barthez Battalion joins Tyson and company in their battle against BEGA. With Emily and Miguel's help, Kenny manages to complete the first of the new Hard Metal Series of Beyblade, Dragoon Metal Storm! But, is it too much for even Tyson to control?!

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x40
episodes_data.description: Training camp continues as Tyson, Daichi, Ray, and Max strive to control their new HMS Beyblades. After several failures and humorous chase scenes, Tyson and the others must look into their hearts to find the answer of how to master complete control. It might even take them back to their childhood...

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x41
episodes_data.description: Under the pretext of gaining more supporters, BEGA holds a qualification tournament to decide the organization's five bladers they'll use in the Justice 5. Garland, Crusher, Ming Ming, and Mystel all secured their entries, and Kai ironically faces Brooklyn for the fifth spot. Will Kai defeat BEGA's secret weapon and get to face Tyson again in the end? Or will the mysterious Brooklyn demonstrate a skill unfathomable to all?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x42
episodes_data.description: Kai tries his best, but he is ultimately outmatched by Brooklyn. So, the BEGA team has been decided, and Tyson's team, the newly-named G-Revolutions, must act accordingly. While he buys a bit more time with ""Mister X"" as their fifth member, Tyson holds on to the wish that HE would join his team...

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x43
episodes_data.description: For the first match, Daichi of Team G-Revolutions faces off against Ming Ming of Team Bega. But during the course of the match, the young pop star has won over the entire crowd, even Kenny! Can Daichi manage to overcome his most formidable opponent by far?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x44
episodes_data.description: The second match against BEGA begins as Ray does battle with the towering Crusher. Crusher's sister, Monica, is having her operation at the same moment, and he must win if he is to pay the expenses needed. Ray fights with the strong desire to save the future of all that is Beyblade, but will it be enough to overcome Crusher and his love for his sister?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x45
episodes_data.description: Team G Revolution have two consecutive losses, so Max is given the pressure to win or face elimination. Can Rick give Max the encouragement he needs to face Mystel in the third match?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x46
episodes_data.description: As Tyson trains intensively for his two consecutive matches against Brooklyn and Garland, a lifeless Kai visits Tala in the hospital and finds Dranzer MS beside him. The new Beyblade literally brings life back in Kai's eyes, and he desperately tries to gain control over it. Can F-Dynasty's coach, Romero, help him out so Kai will be able to rejoin his old team?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x47
episodes_data.description: The fourth match begins with a great surprise. Kai has joined the G-Revolutions! And he demands a rematch with Brooklyn using his new blade, Dranzer MS. Will Kai just lose again to Brooklyn and Zeus' awesome dark powers? Or will his strong emotions turn the tide?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x48
episodes_data.description: The fourth match between Kai and Brooklyn continues! Holding to the little faith he has left in his teammate, Tyson continues to cheer Kai on. As the battle wages on, with every move Brooklyn uses against him, Kai refuses to stay down! Brooklyn finally begins to lose composure to Kai's burning passion for Beyblade, but will the first win for G Revolutions come without a price?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x49
episodes_data.description: It's a grudge match between the two team leaders, Tyson and Garland, in the fifth match! As the descendent of a family who dominates all the world's sports, Garland plans to uphold the family honor by winning this match. Will Tyson be able to stand up to this powerful Beyblader?

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x50
episodes_data.description: G Revolutions and the BEGA Bladers are now tied with two wins, two losses, and a draw. So, a sixth and final match has been announced! But, Boris seems to have other plans when he sends Crusher and Ming Ming to attack Tyson back at his home. This evil man's true colors are beginning to rise to the surface, and loyalty is torn between him and the BEGA Bladers. And what about Brooklyn? Ever since his defeat against Kai, his fate now walks an even darker path...

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x51
episodes_data.description: Finally, it's the tiebreaker match, Tyson versus Brooklyn! But, Brooklyn has changed for the worst after his defeat against Kai, and he completely submits to the seductive darkness of Zeus. This incredible power even threatens the entire world! Will Tyson be able to defeat Brooklyn at this level of intensity?!

episodes_data.title: Beyblade 3x52
episodes_data.description: The match continues, and Brooklyn's dark powers may be too much for Tyson. But, with his old teammates behind him and with the power of Dragoon, Tyson will fight to the very end! And after this climatic battle, it WILL be the end...
